title: corelle white lunch plates
text: corelle white lunch plates. I purchased a weird corelle pattern that doesn't come with lunch size plates and so... I purchased the white ones.  These will work.  They are plain white and will work just fine.  Arrived whole, no chips or cracks.  Hooray Corelle! Light weight and yet TOUGH.  Love them.

product_metadata.title: Corelle 6-Piece 8.5" Lunch Round Plates, Vitrelle Triple Layer Glass, Lightweight Round Plates, Salad Plates, Chip and Scratch Resistant, Microwave and Dishwasher Safe, Brasserie, Medium
features: 6 LUNCH PLATES: This set includes (6) 8.5-inch plates. These mid-sized plates are perfect for salads, desserts, appetizers and more and can be substituted as a serving plate.

VITRELLE STRONG: Featuring triple-layer-strong glass plates and bowls making them resistant to chips, cracks, and scratches. This durable dinnerware set is lightweight, easy to handle, and allows for compact stacking, maximizing your cabinet space.

EASY-TO-CLEAN: This dinnerware set is designed to provide the best dining experience while being ultra-hygienic, non-porous and easy to clean. Plates and bowls are dishwasher safe, freezer safe, and microwave safe.

CLASSIC STYLE: Bring the lively energy, cool ambiance, and relaxed style of a Parisian bistro to your kitchen with these classic brasserie-style bowls. Featuring iconic black rims and details that fit any décor, your table setting will become the perfect place to gather for great food and great conversation.
TIMELESS BEAUTY: Crafted with pride in Corning, New York, Corelle Dinnerware are a staple of modern eating for everyday occasions, filling hearts and tables since 1970.
